title: Apply efficiency only after correctness gates pass
narrative: Taloneth needs harness experiments to satisfy correctness first and only then prefer lower token use, matching gated FineEnvs reward design[^fineenvs-gated].
implementation: `HarnessExperimentRunner.evaluate` accepts an `ObjectivePolicy` and uses gates plus `compare_lexicographic` so efficiency cannot beat a failed correctness gate.
validation: Harness `cli` scenario `gated_objective_evaluate.yaml`. Hard expects on declared observation keys.

footnotes.label: FineEnvs multi-harness RL — what we rewarded
